svg.aria-label: Rev-1 pod board, 34 by 13 mm, both faces side by side to scale, with functional regions, keep-outs, mic port, switch, pad rows, clamp bands and the 7 unrouted connections.
svg.text: Rev-1 pod board: where everything lives (34 × 13 mm, both faces, to scale)
From hw/pod/place_r1.py PLACE and the routed draft hw/pod/draft_r1/pod_r1_routed.kicad_pcb (2026-10-01 19:44). Rough draft: the real layout is done together (O14).
Scale 23 px/mm. Shaded = functional region (by integration-map block). Grey shapes = real copper pads. Replaces pcb-floorplan-rev1 (drawn for 28 × 13).
F face: toward the lid (outer wall)
KiCad top view = the LEFT pod from outside, lid off. Front of the glasses (mic end) on the left.
arm wires rise here: 2.1 mm to the cavity wall
clamp band 0.6: lid rib presses here (red line), no parts
clamp band 0.6: lid rib, no parts
SW1 KMT022 IP68 switch under the lid plunger (bore Ø3.2, stem Ø1.2)
SMPS loop L1 C8 C9 (core 1.1 V)
lid bore Ø1.0 sits 0.77 mm behind the board port
Seen THROUGH the board from F (x-ray), not mirrored: same coordinates as the F panel.
arm wires rise here: 2.1 mm to the cavity wall
clamp band 0.6: foam strip pushes here, no parts
clamp band 0.6: foam strip, no parts
CHARGER U3 BQ25180 (0.4 mm balls), C15 C16 C21, NTC RT1
DOCK/USB protection D3 D4 U6, R12 R13, R18 R19 (+R14 LED)
MIC U2 SPH0641 (bottom port) + R2 C13
H-BRIDGE Q1 Q2, gate pulls R3–R6, C14, shunt R21 (D1 D2 DNP)
LDO U4 C17 C18 + R20 0 Ω link
power: charger, LDO, VBAT sense, pull-ups
board mic port Ø0.6 (dark) / lid bore Ø1.0 (dashed)
J wire pads (F, rear, 1.0 mm), top to bottom: column x 31.4 = J3 DOCK_VBUS, J4 GND, J10 USB_DP, J11 USB_DM, J12 CC, J9 TS · column x 33.0 = J5 VBAT, J6 GND, J1 OUT_A, J2 OUT_B, J7 LED_A, J8 LED_K
TP1–TP6 (F, y 1.3): SWDIO, SWCLK, NRST, +3V0, GND, VSYS (pogo P50 jig; the row clears the clamp band by 0.35 mm)
Unrouted, 7 (drc.json 2026-10-01 19:44): 1 OUT_A stub at Q1 · 2 BTN U1.10 ↔ SW1 track · 3 I2C_SDA U1.27 ↔ R16 · 4 I2C_SDA U1.27 ↔ U3.C1 · 5 N$3 U1.31 ↔ R11 · 6 VSYS at U3.B2 · 7 VBUS U3.A2 ↔ C15

Heights: F parts ≤ 1.2 mm (lid inner face 1.5 mm above F) · B parts ≤ 1.2 mm (cell top 1.4 mm below B, foam strips between). Board 0.8 mm target (the draft .kicad_pcb still says 1.6), 4 layers: F.Cu · In1 solid GND · In2 signals · B.Cu

Both pods: one board, F toward the lid, mic end forward. In the right pod (the hw/mech CAD) the TP edge (board y 0) is at the bottom: seen from outside, KiCad's top view rotated 180° [derived]. Mic port and switch sit on the centre line y 6.5 (O16-5).
